title: DATA: Production database project-lab junction reconciliation dry-run review (A16)

labels.name: parked
labels.description: Out of the audit countdown by YY's decision; not closed, resumes later

body:
### Scope & Context
In automated testing (A16), the reconciliation dry-run, apply, and rerun cycle was verified on isolated fixtures to be fully idempotent with zero data corruption or unintended grant expansions.

### Production Execution Policy
- Production holds 36,870 live samples. In accordance with zero-unreviewed-production-mutation policies, no automatic database migrations or grant expansions shall be run without prior DBA review.
- Run a read-only discrepancy report via \projectMembershipService.getDiscrepancyReport()\ against the production database snapshot.
- If any legacy projects have divergence between \ProjectLab\ and legacy JSON columns, present the diff for review before executing an authorized patch.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Read-only report executed and reviewed with zero unreviewed production writes.
- 36,870 live samples remain 100% intact.
